This directory contains a fixed, version-controlled set of native dependency license texts. Builds copy these files directly; they do not scan the host or collect license files automatically.

The snapshots cover the reviewed Windows runtime DLL bundle. Linux wheels link against system-provided native libraries rather than bundling them. See README.md in this directory for component versions and update instructions.

Dependency sources:
https://github.com/msys2/MINGW-packages
https://src.fedoraproject.org/
https://almalinux.org/
